# Exalus Home Bridge Add-on

This add-on allows you to integrate the Exalus Home TR7 system with Home Assistant.

### Requirements
- Connected TR7 Controller
- Mosquitto broker Add-on
- Enabled MQTT Integration

### Installation

1. Install the Exalus Home Bridge add-on
2. Enable MQTT integration in your home assistant instance and install official Mosquitto MQTT Broker add-on
  
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">

3. Configure the Exalus Home Bridge add-on - Go to the add-on settings (Settings -> Apps -> Exalus Home Bridge) 
    
    The add-on has 3 configuration sections: 

     **controller** - related to the controller connection 

            serial - The serial number of the TR7 controller we want to connect to.
            pin - The PIN of the TR7 controller.
            username - Controller user - you can use your own user or use the default one (installator@installator).
            password - Controller user password (the default for the installator is a combination of the serial number and PIN).
            run_from_cloud - This switch forces connection to the controller via the Exalus cloud 
            - if the switch is off, the add-on will search for the controller on the local network:
            - if the controller is found, the add-on will connect to it locally
            - if it is not found, the add-on will connect via the cloud
            - if it is found but the local connection fails, the add-on will throw an error, in which case you should try turning on the switch 

    **mqtt** - related to mqtt integration with home assistant 

            host - MQTT broker hostname - default after installing core-mosquitto.
            port - MQTT broker port.
            username - MQTT broker username - you can use the credentials of a Home Assistant user, or create a new one in the settings of the Mqtt Mosquitto add-on.
            password - MQTT broker user password - your Home Assistant password, or the password you created.
            baseTopic - Discovery prefix of MQTT integration - default ‘homeassistant’ - can be changed in MQTT integration settings.

    **general** - general settings of the add-on

            logLevel - Add-on login level - set to “Warning” by default.


    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">

    3. Launch the add-on and enjoy integration with Home Assistant ;)
